coverage.approved_model_contract: The approved local model registry records an immutable model revision, license, model-card reference, generation application, access conditions, and review basis.
coverage.required_metadata_contract: The generation workflow requires model identity/revision, prompt, negative prompt, seed, sampler/settings, source/release hashes, accessible equivalent, human review, approval, and registry linkage.
coverage.current_preview_boundary: All seven preserved portrait previews have source hashes, prompts, written equivalents, and generic fallbacks, but their actual model identity, immutable revision, sampler, and seed are unavailable; they remain unverified and pending.
coverage.promotion_boundary: The existing validator rejects a promotion-shaped preview when required model/seed provenance or portrait review is missing.
coverage.release_boundary: The generation manifest and visual registry contain no portrait preview entries; release paths, release hashes, and registry IDs remain null.

limits: This closes only the current repository-owned technical metadata readiness and fail-closed promotion boundary.
It does not provide the actual model identity, immutable revision, sampler, or seed for any existing preview.

Per-portrait identity, resemblance, protected-mark, artifact, accessibility, small-size, grayscale, legal, ownership, training-data, release-derivative, registry, human-review, and public-release readiness gates remain open.
No portrait is approved, released, loaded by the GUI, or represented as a player-visible actor fact.
